cases.sentence: Самуил сказал Саулу о мести ___ Господом.
cases.translation: Samuel told Saul about vengeance against the Amalekites by the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) or the sense of vengeance 'upon' requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Саул разбил ___ на всем пути от Хавилы до Шура.
cases.translation: Saul defeated the Amalekites along the entire route from Havilah to Shur.
cases.explain: The transitive verb разбил (defeated) governs the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: He took Agag, the king of the Amalekites, alive.
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb взял (took) is in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Саул и его войско пощадили Агага, ___ амаликитян.
cases.translation: Saul and his army spared Agag, king of the Amalekites.
cases.explain: Agag as the direct object of the verb пощадили (spared) is in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Но Саул и его войско пощадили лучших овец и валов, как добычу ___.
cases.translation: But Saul and his army spared the best sheep and cattle as spoils of war.
cases.explain: The genitive case with добычу (spoils) shows possession or relation.

cases.sentence: Слово Господа пришло к ___, говоря я жалею о Сауле.
cases.translation: The word of the Lord came to Samuel, saying I regret Saul.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) with a person governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Самуил разгневался и всю ночь взывал к ___ в слезах.
cases.translation: Samuel was angry and cried out to the Lord all night.
cases.explain: The verb взывал (cried out) with the preposition к requires the dative case.

cases.sentence: Тогда Самуил сказал, «Разве всесожжение и жертвы столь же приятны ___, как послушание?»
cases.translation: Then Samuel said, 'Are burnt offerings and sacrifices as pleasing to the Lord as obedience?'
cases.explain: The adjective приятны (pleasing) with a person requires the dative case.

reading.ru: Саул разбил амаликитян на всем пути от Хавилы до самого Шура, что в Восточном Египте.
reading.question: How far did Saul's victory over the Amalekites extend?
options: From Havilah to Shur in Eastern Egypt
reading.correct: From Havilah to Shur in Eastern Egypt
reading.explain: The text states that Saul defeated the Amalekites 'на всем пути от Хавилы до самого Шура, что в Восточном Египте.'

reading.ru: Но Саул и его войско пощадили Агага. Они также оставили лучших овец и валов, жирных телят и игнят, все, что было ценно.
reading.question: What did Saul and his army refuse to destroy?
options: Agag and the best of the livestock
reading.correct: Agag and the best of the livestock
reading.explain: Saul and his army spared Agag and the finest sheep, cattle, calves, and lambs—everything of value.

reading.ru: Самуил разгневался и всю ночь взывал Господу.
reading.question: How did Samuel respond to news that Saul had disobeyed?
options: He became angry and cried out to the Lord all night
reading.correct: He became angry and cried out to the Lord all night
reading.explain: The text says 'Самуил разгневался и всю ночь взывал Господу' — Samuel was angry and called out to the Lord all night.

reading.ru: Самуил сказал. «Не стал ли ты главой родов Израиля, хотя сам когда-то невысоко себя ставил?»
reading.question: What did Samuel remind Saul about his former status?
options: That Saul was made head of the tribes of Israel though he was humble
That Saul was the bravest of all soldiers
That Saul was born a king
That Saul had always been powerful
reading.correct: That Saul was made head of the tribes of Israel though he was humble
reading.explain: Samuel told Saul 'Не стал ли ты главой родов Израиля, хотя сам когда-то невысоко себя ставил?' — Were you not made head of the tribes of Israel, though you were humble of heart?

reading.ru: Разве всесожжение и жертвы столь же приятны Господу, сколь послушание голосу Господа? Послушание лучше жертвы, и повиновение лучше жира баранов.
reading.question: What did Samuel say was better than sacrifices?
reading.explain: Samuel declared 'Послушание лучше жертвы, и повиновение лучше жира баранов' — Obedience is better than sacrifice, and submission better than the fat of rams.

reading.ru: Саул сказал, сегодня я нарушил наставления Господа и твои слова, потому что я боялся народа и уступил им.
reading.question: Why did Saul say he disobeyed God's command?
options: He feared the people and obeyed their voice
He did not understand the command
He wanted to keep the treasure
He forgot what God had said
reading.correct: He feared the people and obeyed their voice
reading.explain: Saul admitted 'я боялся народа и уступил им' — I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
